This is the backend of the application which involves planning a wedding. The application will help users to organize and manage various aspects of their wedding, including guest lists, budgets, vendors, and schedules. It will provide tools for creating checklists, tracking expenses, and sending invitations. 
The goal is to make the wedding planning process easier and more efficient for couples. 
While generating code make sure it is efficient and does not allow for any mistakes especially calculation wise.
Since any mistake for example in allocation of budget or guest list can lead to significant issues, the application should include validation checks and error handling to prevent such mistakes.
We are using Java 25 and Spring boot 4, so generate code accordingly.
Do not use any local database setup or JPA configurations, For database we use Supabase.
